prompt:
Create one production-ready neutral bind-pose full-body source of Vivhite, faithfully reconstructing the same character shown in the two reference images. This is clean 2D cutout-animation production art, not a dramatic illustration. Render a single anime game character in strict orthographic front view, perfectly centered and upright in a symmetrical A-pose. Keep both straight arms about 30 degrees away from the torso, elbows unbent, wrists straight, open relaxed hands fully visible with five anatomically correct separated fingers on each hand. Keep both straight legs slightly apart at hip width, knees and ankles clearly readable, and both feet pointing forward on the same baseline. Show the entire character from the top of the butterfly ornament to the soles of both boots, with generous uniform unused margin on every side and no cropping.

Preserve the exact Vivhite identity and costume from the references: short layered silver-white bob haircut; vivid violet-pink eyes; thin round gold glasses; one cyan-to-cobalt blue butterfly hair ornament; cool, cute, emotionally reserved expression; black, white and deep navy magical-girl dress with pale-lavender panels and fine gold trim; violet crystal pendant; asymmetrical dark-blue shoulder ornament with its gold fitting; white segmented forearm guards; white thigh-high stockings with gold emblems; navy ankle boots with violet crystals. Match the youthful proportions, face, color palette and garment construction. Use crisp near-opaque cel-painted materials and uniform neutral studio lighting confined completely inside the character silhouette. Every hair strand, skin edge and garment edge must end in a hard precise production contour with only normal one-pixel antialiasing. Make shoulders, elbows, wrists, individual fingers, hips, knees, ankles, hair silhouette and skirt panels structurally clear for a newly authored weighted 2D skeletal mesh.

Empty hands only. No sword, staff, wand, rod, blade, spellbook, shield, held orb or any weapon. No long ribbon, white silk strip, bandage, cape, helmet, heavy armor, extra person, extra limb, duplicated limb, missing limb, fused fingers, duplicated fingers, missing fingers, distorted hands, text, letters, numbers, logo, signature or watermark. No rim light, aura, outer glow, bloom, light spill, fuzzy luminous outline, halo, magical particles, mist, scenery, floor, pedestal, contact shadow or cast shadow.
